questions.questionText: A cube-shaped dice has six different letters, one on each face: P, Q, R, S, T, U. It is shown in 3 positions; in each position three faces meeting at a corner are visible. Position I shows T, R and U. Position II shows U, P and R. Position III shows T, U and Q. Which letter is on the face opposite to S?

questions.questionText: 1 identical standard dice (opposite faces sum to 7) are stacked in a vertical column on the floor, face to face. The faces on the ground and the faces in contact are hidden; all other faces can be seen. What is the largest possible total of the visible numbers?
questions.explanation: Total of all faces = 21 × 1 = 21. Each dice hides its bottom face, and every dice with another above it also hides its top face (opposite bottom: sum 7), so hidden total = 7 × 0 + (bottom face of top dice). To make the visible sum largest, that last hidden face is 1. Hidden = 1, visible = 20.
questions.shortcut: Hidden = 7 for every dice except the top one, which hides a single face.

questions.questionText: 4 identical standard dice (opposite faces sum to 7) are stacked in a vertical column on the floor, face to face. The faces on the ground and the faces in contact are hidden; all other faces can be seen. What is the smallest possible total of the visible numbers?
questions.explanation: Total of all faces = 21 × 4 = 84. Each dice hides its bottom face, and every dice with another above it also hides its top face (opposite bottom: sum 7), so hidden total = 7 × 3 + (bottom face of top dice). To make the visible sum smallest, that last hidden face is 6. Hidden = 27, visible = 57.
questions.shortcut: Hidden = 7 for every dice except the top one, which hides a single face.

questions.questionText: How many faces of a dice are adjacent to (share an edge with) any one given face?
questions.explanation: A cube has 6 faces; one is the face itself and one is opposite, leaving 4 adjacent faces.

questions.questionText: How many pairs of opposite faces does a dice have?
questions.explanation: 6 faces form 6/2 = 3 opposite pairs.
questions.shortcut: Faces ÷ 2.

questions.questionText: At how many corners (vertices) of a dice do three faces meet, and how many such corners are there in all?
questions.explanation: Every corner of a cube joins exactly three faces and a cube has 8 corners, so there are 8 such meeting points.
questions.shortcut: Cube: 8 vertices.

questions.questionText: Three faces of a dice meeting at a corner are always:
options: Mutually adjacent, no two of them opposite
All three opposite to each other
questions.explanation: At a corner each face touches the other two along an edge, so none of the three pairs is an opposite pair.
questions.shortcut: Corner faces are never opposite.

questions.questionText: A standard dice (opposite faces sum to 7) shows 1, 2 and 3 on the three faces visible at a corner. What is the sum of the three hidden faces?
questions.explanation: The hidden faces are opposite to 1, 2, 3: 6, 5, 4. Sum = 21 − 6 = 15.
questions.shortcut: Hidden = 21 − visible.

questions.questionText: A standard dice (opposite faces sum to 7) shows 2, 3 and 4 on the three faces visible at a corner. What is the sum of the three hidden faces?
questions.explanation: The hidden faces are opposite to 2, 3, 4: 5, 4, 3. Sum = 21 − 9 = 12.
questions.shortcut: Hidden = 21 − visible.

questions.questionText: A standard dice (opposite faces sum to 7) shows 4, 5 and 6 on the three faces visible at a corner. What is the sum of the three hidden faces?
questions.explanation: The hidden faces are opposite to 4, 5, 6: 3, 2, 1. Sum = 21 − 15 = 6.
questions.shortcut: Hidden = 21 − visible.

questions.questionText: A standard dice (opposite faces sum to 7) shows 1, 5 and 6 on the three faces visible at a corner. What is the sum of the three hidden faces?
questions.explanation: The hidden faces are opposite to 1, 5, 6: 6, 2, 1. Sum = 21 − 12 = 9.
questions.shortcut: Hidden = 21 − visible.

questions.questionText: A standard dice (opposite faces sum to 7) shows 2, 4 and 5 on the three faces visible at a corner. What is the sum of the three hidden faces?
questions.explanation: The hidden faces are opposite to 2, 4, 5: 5, 3, 2. Sum = 21 − 11 = 10.
questions.shortcut: Hidden = 21 − visible.

questions.questionText: A standard dice (opposite faces sum to 7) shows 3, 4 and 6 on the three faces visible at a corner. What is the sum of the three hidden faces?
questions.explanation: The hidden faces are opposite to 3, 4, 6: 4, 3, 1. Sum = 21 − 13 = 8.
questions.shortcut: Hidden = 21 − visible.
